text:
emma: brief idea: add `affinity_tag` + `deprecation_state` to pin metadata to express preferred locality and soft deprecation. want quick sanity check.

noah: okay — what's the shape? short example pls.

emma: `affinity_tag=region:eu-west1`, `deprecation_state=soft`, `deprecation_until=2026-06-01T00:00:00Z`, `release_epoch=2026-04-05T12:00:00Z`. keep fields optional.

li: behavior: soft = steer new sessions away, allow active sessions to finish; hard = reject new sessions. correct?

emma: yes. resolvers implement fallback: affinity -> region siblings -> global. schema only stores tag.

noah: indexing concerns? ops wants fast queries by affinity + scope and by deprecation state.

emma: add composite index (affinity_tag, scope) + index on deprecation_state. low-cardinality expected.

li: migration/backfill?

emma: two-phase backfill: annotate pins from tenant defaults (no-op) then enable resolver checks. emit telemetry pin.backfill.start and pin.backfill.done.

ops-bot: routing: we will add flag `honor_deprecation=false` as a cluster-wide kill-switch.

noah: include meta.rev and origin fields to detect mass accidental changes.

li: +1 to RFC if you include sample console mockups and rollout checklist.

emma: will draft RFC tonight; thanks! :thumbsup:
